source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS fragments (4Q201-4Q207; late 3rd c. BCE through 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Greek Akhmim Panopolitanus (6th c. CE) where Aramaic absent; Ge'ez (medieval; the only complete witness) as fallback
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic transliteration per Milik 1976 (ḥ ṣ ʿ ḫ); Greek SBL convention (η→ē, ω→ō, θ→th, etc., matching Matthew precedent); Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention (ḫ ḫ̣ ʾ ʿ ä for ä-vowel)
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976 DJD apparatus + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia + original codicology
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch + Black 1985 Greek text + Charles 1912 Ge'ez PD + Knibb 1978 Ge'ez critical edition + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia commentary
source.citation: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch (Oxford); Black 1985 The Book of Enoch or 1 Enoch (SVTP 7, Leiden); Nickelsburg 2001 1 Enoch 1 Hermeneia; Charles 1912 The Book of Enoch (Oxford, PD); Knibb 1978 The Ethiopic Book of Enoch (Oxford); Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI; Bauckham 1998 The Fate of the Dead; Bernstein 1996 The Formation of Hell.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 27 — THE ACCURSED VALLEY / VALLEY OF HINNOM / GEHENNA — Aramaic 4Q204 1 xi-xii partial; Greek Akhmim 27:1-5 complete; Ge'ez full. Uriel as guide. **MAJOR LENS-RISK + NT CROSS-CORPUS SITE — the etymological + conceptual source of γέεννα/Gehenna.**

verses.text_greek: Τότε εἶπον· Διὰ τί ἡ γῆ αὕτη ἡ εὐλογημένη καὶ πεπληρωμένη δένδρων, καὶ ἡ φάραγξ αὕτη ἐν μέσῳ ἐπικατάρατός ἐστιν;
verses.translit: Tote eipon; Dia ti hē gē hautē hē eulogēmenē kai peplērōmenē dendrōn, kai hē pharanx hautē en mesō epikataratos estin?
verses.text_geez: ይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ እቤ፡ በእንተ፡ ምንት፡ ዛቲ፡ ምድር፡ ቡርክት፡ ወምልዕት፡ ዕፀወ፡ ወዛቲ፡ ቈላት፡ እንተ፡ ማእከል፡ ርግምት፡ ይእቲ፡
verses.notes: Enoch's question — why is this central valley accursed (epikataratos) while the surrounding land is blessed?

verses.text_greek: Τότε ἀπεκρίθη μοι Οὐριήλ, ὁ εἷς τῶν ἁγίων ἀγγέλων ὃς μετ' ἐμοῦ ἦν, καὶ εἶπεν· Αὕτη ἡ φάραγξ ἡ κατηραμένη τῶν κατηραμένων μέχρι αἰῶνος· ὧδε συναχθήσονται πάντες οἱ κατηραμένοι, οἵτινες λαλήσουσιν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν κατὰ κυρίου λόγον ἀπρεπῆ καὶ περὶ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ σκληρὰ λαλήσουσιν· ὧδε συναχθήσονται καὶ ὧδε ἔσται τὸ οἰκητήριον αὐτῶν.
verses.translit: Tote apekrithē moi Ouriēl, ho heis tōn hagiōn angelōn hos met' emou ēn, kai eipen; Hautē hē pharanx hē katēramenē tōn katēramenōn mechri aiōnos; hōde synachthēsontai pantes hoi katēramenoi, hoitines lalēsousin tō stomati autōn kata kyriou logon aprepē kai peri tēs doxēs autou sklēra lalēsousin; hōde synachthēsontai kai hōde estai to oikētērion autōn.
verses.text_geez: ይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ አውሥአኒ፡ ዑርኤል፡ አሐዱ፡ እመላእክት፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ዘምስሌየ፡ ሀሎ፡ ወይቤ፡ ዛቲ፡ ቈላት፡ ርግምት፡ ለርጉማን፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ ዝየ፡ ይትጋብኡ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ርጉማን፡ እለ፡ ይትናገሩ፡ በአፉሆሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ እግዚእ፡ ቃለ፡ ኢ፡ ድልወ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ስብሐቱ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ ይትናገሩ፡ ዝየ፡ ይትጋብኡ፡ ወዝየ፡ ይከውን፡ ማኅደሮሙ፡
verses.notes: **THE ACCURSED VALLEY — eschatological gathering-place for those who blaspheme.** **MAJOR LENS-RISK + CROSS-CORPUS — THE PROTOTYPE OF GEHENNA.** Cross-corpus: Josh 15:8, 18:16 (Ge-Hinnom, 'Valley of Hinnom,' SW of Jerusalem); 2 Kgs 23:10 (Josiah defiles the Tophet 'so that no one might burn his son or daughter as an offering to Molech'); Jer 7:31-32, 19:6 (Jeremiah curses the valley); Jer 32:35. **NT cross-corpus is MAXIMAL**: γέεννα appears 12x in NT (Mt 5:22, 5:29-30, 10:28, 18:9, 23:15, 23:33; Mk 9:43, 45, 47; Lk 12:5; Jas 3:6). 1 En 27:1-5 is **the earliest extant text that takes the Jerusalem Valley of Hinnom as the cosmic-eschatological place of judgment** — the bridge between the OT cult-defilement site and the NT 'hell' lexeme. **The Editor will need to handle this with maximal care — γέεννα is one of the load-bearing NT lexemes that comes directly from this Enochic development.**

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις ἔσται ἐπ' αὐτῶν τὸ θέαμα τῆς κρίσεως τῆς δικαίας ἐνώπιον τῶν δικαίων εἰς ἅπαντα τὸν αἰῶνα· ὧδε εὐλογήσουσιν οἱ ἐλεήμονες τὸν κύριον τῆς δόξης, τὸν βασιλέα τοῦ αἰῶνος.
verses.translit: Kai en tais eschatais hēmerais estai ep' autōn to theama tēs kriseōs tēs dikaias enōpion tōn dikaiōn eis hapanta ton aiōna; hōde eulogēsousin hoi eleēmones ton kyrion tēs doxēs, ton basilea tou aiōnos.
verses.text_geez: ወበደኃሪ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይከውን፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ራእየ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ ዝየ፡ ይባርክዎ፡ መሐርያን፡ ለእግዚአ፡ ስብሐት፡ ንጉሠ፡ ዓለም፡
verses.notes: The cursed-valley judgment is a spectacle (theama) viewed by the righteous. Cross-corpus: Isa 66:24 ('they shall go forth and look upon the corpses of the men who have transgressed against me'); cf. the Lk 16:23 view of Lazarus and the rich man across the chasm; cf. Rev 14:9-11 (the righteous see the torment of the wicked).

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς κρίσεως αὐτῶν εὐλογήσουσιν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει, ὃ ἐμέρισεν αὐτοῖς.
verses.translit: Kai en tais hēmerais tēs kriseōs autōn eulogēsousin auton epi tō eleei, ho emerisen autois.
verses.text_geez: ወበመዋዕለ፡ ኵነኔሆሙ፡ ይባርክዎ፡ በምሕረት፡ ዘዓደለ፡ ሎሙ፡
verses.notes: The righteous bless God for the mercy he has apportioned them in distinction from the cursed.

verses.text_greek: Τότε εὐλόγησα τὸν κύριον τῆς δόξης καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ ἐδήλωσα καὶ ὕμνησα μεγαλωσύνῃ.
verses.translit: Tote eulogēsa ton kyrion tēs doxēs kai tēn doxan autou edēlōsa kai hymnēsa megalōsynē.
verses.text_geez: ይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ባረክዎ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ ስብሐት፡ ወክብሮ፡ አክሠትኩ፡ ወአስብሕክዎ፡ በዕበይ፡
verses.notes: Enoch's closing doxology to the Lord of Glory.
